title: Baroque Shell Bracelet
category: Bracelet (strand of flat baroque shell pearls on an 18k gold tone toggle, with 1 drop pearl, sold as 1)
metal: 18k gold tone (PVD 18K gold coating on surgical stainless steel findings: spacer beads, end beads, jump rings, toggle), polished warm finish. The pearls are shell pearl, white with a soft pink-silver lustre and rippled, uneven surfaces. One variant only; every photo shows this tone, there is no rhodium silver tone option.
lock: 1 strand of 8 flat, irregular baroque shell pearls (about 9-20 mm, white with soft pink-silver lustre, every one a different shape), 7 small round spacer beads between them, a small and a larger bead at each end; 18k gold tone toggle: round ring about 12 mm, straight T-bar about 20 mm; 1 larger baroque pearl drop hanging from the toggle on a jump ring. Must stay flat, lumpy and mismatched pearls, never round, uniform or matched pearls.
morph: The pearls. Image models regularise baroque pearls into a classic strand of round, matched, evenly sized pearls (or rice/potato freshwater pearls), shrink them all to one size, or add pearls (the strand has exactly 8 plus 1 drop). Second risks: the drop pearl vanishes or doubles; the toggle becomes a lobster clasp or turns to the back; the small spacer beads grow into a chain. Third: colour cast on the white pearls (lilac on lilac paper, pink/red in a red room; plan.json already logs red cast on white shell pearls); verify at zoom. Note: the description says the drop hangs from the T-bar, but every photo (01-05, 07) shows it on a jump ring under the toggle ring.
sizeMm: Approximately 21 cm long, about 27.6 g (listing). Pearls listed as 9-11 mm, toggle about 12 mm, drop pearl about 11 mm (size guide photo 07). Measured against the size guide's own markers, the strand pearls actually run from about 9 mm (the smallest) to about 18-20 mm across (the 2 large flat ones at the back), the drop about 11 x 14 mm and the T-bar about 20 mm long (estimates, not listed). Worn (photo 05), 4-5 pearls cover the top of the wrist and the drop pearl spans about a third of the wrist's width; in photo 04 the whole bracelet sits loose round the wrist.
mediaIdSource: No earlier media ids existed for this handle (no section in ads-500 products.md, no plan.json lock, no ads-500 refs, nothing in concept-camps refs). Imported 2026-11-20 into Higgsfield from the two Shopify CDN listing URLs (01 packshot, 05 worn).
claimsNote: Not Waterproof: the listing has no Waterproof tag and its Care block says keep it out of the shower, the pool and the sea (keep-it-on/README.md already bars it from the waterproof campaign). Tarnish Free applies to the PVD-coated findings; the pearls are softer than metal and dislike chemicals.
variants: 1 variant: Default Title, 18k gold tone, stock 18. Show the one bracelet with the toggle turned to the top of the wrist so the drop pearl swings free (the listing's own styling tip).
story: Pearls that were never asked to match: 8 flat baroque shell pearls, each its own shape with its own ripple and lustre, and the closure worn at the front as the point, with 1 drop pearl always in motion. Lovable for the imperfection and the weight (27.6 g, the big flat pearls fill the wrist), and for the heirloom feeling without the stiffness of a round pearl strand. It rhymes with a grandmother's pearls made loose and modern, warm skin and a slip or ochre silk (as in worn photo 04), cream khadi and handloom (photo 03), and the toggle family (Toggle Link Chain, Heartbead's gold toggle). It is a dry-land piece: never water scenes.
campFit: Against the two camps the user rates highly. LILAC (lilac handmade paper, lavender, rhodium only; one device, a perforated stamp cancelled by a postmark): the white baroque pearls and their pink-silver lustre suit the paper's softness (Pearl Blossom Earrings already sat there), but the 18k gold tone breaks LILAC's rhodium-only rule and white pearls grade lilac on that paper, the camp's logged fault. The Red Room (red lacquer ground, cinema light; devices like R1 Look Closer loupes and R4 The List): the pearls would be the brightest thing in the frame and the loupe device suits their ripples, but red cast on white shell pearls is a logged risk; keep the pearls neutral white and verify at zoom.
copyNotes: Use: baroque shell pearl(s), flat baroque shell pearls, each a different shape, 18k gold tone, PVD 18k gold tone findings, toggle clasp worn at the front, T-bar, drop pearl, 21 cm, 27.6 g, pearls 9-11 mm (the listed figure; do not print the 20 mm estimate), surgical stainless steel findings, tarnish free, hypoallergenic. Avoid: 'pearl' alone outside the product name (say shell pearl); freshwater, cultured, natural, real, Akoya, South Sea, mother-of-pearl; 'gold' or 'gold toggle' without 'tone' (the description says 'gold toggle': write 18k gold tone toggle), solid gold; waterproof, shower-proof, swim-safe or any water scene; 'anti-tarnish' (say tarnish free); matched, uniform, round pearls; chain or link for the strand (it is strung pearls with beads); lobster clasp; huggie; rhodium or silver tone for this piece.
